$comment: The reconstructed pre-0.3.0 specialized graph_* tool surface, for Phase E's MCP tool-selection benchmark (docs/improvement-plan-provenance-diff.md) to compare the consolidated `graph(relation=...)` tool against. Recoverable from ROADMAP.md's own enumeration of the pre-consolidation surface; not a live schema (those 13 tools no longer exist in okf-mcp as of 0.3.0). Kept in sync with okf_mcp::tool_selection_benchmark::specialized_tool_name() by a dedicated consistency test.
note: Every one of these 13 tools took the same single argument the corresponding graph relation takes today (e.g. graph_callers took `id`, graph_path took `from`/`to`), just as its own dedicated tool rather than one value of a shared `relation` enum. `explain` postdates this surface entirely -- see questions.json's note on it -- so it has no entry here.
